No worries. Going from 500k request to 25k is a big jump so it might be worth just starting again and going right back to basics. 

Let's maybe chat next week with [@Pet Berisha](/edgeware/account/iD3QwESnDJC5nSNPYH7ZXAviQ3yvPapfVMufUef3BM4aTmf) too

full_text:
hey [@Juanlinebreaker](/ethereum/account/0x1D535094E818b46C3CbfB212902f16738c1caF9C) thanks for sharing this. 

Sounds like you've been busy, congratulations your success so far. 

I'd caveat the following with the fact that developing and funding proposals does take time and i'd say the most productive relationships we have are those where there has been a lot of discussion with teams who have a very specific vision of what they'd like to create/build that then needs to be married to our existing resources, capabilities and issues. 

Some background as well - your area of focus is actually something I know a fair amount about as I was a cofounder of [Copa90](https://copa90.media) and [@Pet Berisha](/edgeware/account/iD3QwESnDJC5nSNPYH7ZXAviQ3yvPapfVMufUef3BM4aTmf) (who has an EDG funded project [GMI in Crypto Media](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series)) is also deeply involved in football / crypto so may have a useful perspective. 

**Questions / notes / thoughts**

You mention the below in relation to the 5% bonding fees. 

- _BTL could provide 5-10% of BTL’s equity to Edgeware in a S.A.F.E_


This is maybe a misunderstanding of the system. If you request funds then someone needs to put forward 5% of the funding request. 

Right now, I'm not sure why we would leap straight into conversations about taking an equity stake in your business. 

Onto your project focus: 

- _Organize & automate Editorial Ops, optimizing the workflow for content creators (current and potential) _
- _Create BTL Toolbox and a new platform for content creators _
- _Increase the number of articles published per day/month/year _
- _Create new products aligned to BTL branding and values _
- _Generate revenue from BTL products _
- _Compensate BTL Team & collabs through crypto _


All of these things are complex challenges in of themselves that can really only be understood and solved through iterative development and likely with dedicated teams who are specialists in each area. 

It is unfeasible, not to say impossible for you to address these challenges on our emerging technology stack - I would stick to your core competency of sports media / journalism and community building. 

We are gradually biting off chunks of this through targeting funding of people who each bring little pieces of the puzzle together. 

- Funding request of $500,000k / 69m EDG


You clearly have a strong vision and talent but given our experience so far, the best thing to do is to start with a much smaller and more achieveable goal that gives you (and the community) a chance to make mistakes and learn with less pressure and expectation. 

We are building as we go, solving challenges as they come up and its only once you're contributing do you realise how complex these undertakings are.

[@Ramsey](/edgeware/account/k43sLKozrmQq7d7aqpYCzqiUM7DJgMaMrVsrY1uPQvpZLWT) - one of the core community devs in Edgeware and technical steward of Kabocha says it best when he explains Edgeware as an ashram for Web3 founders... this is where you start your journey... you need to sweep the floors a bit, to build experience, to get a feel for the people and project and indeed the area you can best contribute - and in turn, this is how the community understands how they can help you achieve your goals. 

**Recommendation **

My recommendation is to reduce your scope and your funding request to around $25k which is pretty much our standard entry level funding.

What does that look like? 

Happy to help you figure this out.
